name: dms
description: 0 - Dynamic Model Selection as a Claude Code mod: cost-first model routing in code. Switches the main model only on a clear win while the cache is cheap to lose, keeps every model a caller sets, and routes unset subagents of an Opus parent to a cheaper tier when a small Haiku judge is confident.

switchMain.title: Switch the main model
switchMain.description: Switch the main conversation's model on a clear win. Off: recommend only.

maxSwitchContext.title: Largest context to switch at
maxSwitchContext.description: Above this many context tokens a switch would re-read too much without the cache, so DMS only recommends.

minWords.title: Shortest prompt considered
minWords.description: Prompts with fewer words are never judged.

cooldownPrompts.title: Prompts between switches
cooldownPrompts.description: After a switch, the next prompts are not judged, so the model does not flip back and forth.

upConfidence.title: Confidence to move up
upConfidence.description: How sure the judge must be to move to a higher tier.

downConfidence.title: Confidence to move down
downConfidence.description: How sure the judge must be to move to a lower tier.

routeUnsetSubagents.title: Route unset subagents
routeUnsetSubagents.description: When a subagent names no model and the parent runs on the deep tier, let the judge pick a cheaper tier.

timeoutMs.title: Judge time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.description: After this, the prompt or spawn goes ahead unchanged.

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model id for the fast tier.

balancedModel.title: Balanced tier
balancedModel.description: Model id for the balanced tier.

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model id for the deep tier.
